gold.user: As a developer, I want to retrieve a list of all indexes in my Meilisearch instance so that I can manage and monitor them effectively.
gold.ideal: The response should include an array of index objects, each containing details like indexUid, name, and document count.

gold.user: As a data engineer, I need to create a new index for my dataset to enable efficient searching and retrieval of documents.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the creation of the index with its unique indexUid and a success message.

gold.user: As a user, I want to fetch details of a specific index by its UID to understand its configuration and status.
gold.ideal: The response should return the index object with properties like indexUid, name, and settings.

gold.user: As an administrator, I need to update the settings of an existing index to optimize its performance for search queries.
gold.ideal: The response should indicate the successful update of the index with the updated settings reflected.

gold.user: As a system maintainer, I want to delete an unused index to free up resources and maintain a clean environment.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the deletion of the index with a success message.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to swap two indexes to facilitate a seamless transition between versions of my search data.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the successful swap of the indexes with their new states reflected.
